extraction.text:
V SARAVANAN

Principal AI & GenAI Architect | AI Platform Engineering | Agentic AI | Azure AI | Enterprise Architecture | Python | .NET
Chennai, India | +91 7338966163 | vsaravananjob@gmail.com
LinkedIn: www.linkedin.com/in/saravanan-v-74023441b

EXECUTIVE PROFILE

Principal AI & GenAI Architect with 20+ years of enterprise software engineering and architecture experience, including 7+ years delivering AI, GenAI and intelligent automation solutions. Experienced in designing enterprise AI platforms, LLM-powered applications, RAG architectures, agentic workflows, cloud-native microservices, and AI governance on Azure and AWS. Strong background in Python and .NET, enterprise integration, distributed systems, and modernization across Healthcare, Banking, Insurance, Retail and Financial Services. Known for leading architecture strategy, mentoring engineering teams, driving AI adoption, and delivering scalable, secure, production-grade AI solutions.

CORE EXPERTISE

AI & GenAI: Azure OpenAI, Amazon Bedrock, LLMs, RAG, Prompt Engineering, AI Agents, Multi-Agent Systems, AI Guardrails, AI Governance
• AI Platform Engineering: LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, MCP, AI Orchestration, Vector Search, Embeddings
• Cloud: Azure AI, AWS (Amazon Bedrock, Lambda, ECS/EKS, API Gateway, SQS), AKS, Azure Functions, Service Bus, Event Grid, API Management, Logic Apps
• Architecture: Enterprise Architecture, Domain-Driven Design, Event-Driven Architecture, Microservices, API-first
• Engineering: Python, C#, .NET, ASP.NET Core, REST APIs
• Enterprise Integration: SAP, Salesforce, Power Platform, RPA (UiPath, Automation Anywhere) as AI enablement

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Solution Architect – Aspire Systems | Jan 2026 – Present

Architect enterprise-scale Azure and AWS cloud-native microservices and AI-ready platforms.
• Drive GenAI adoption using Azure OpenAI, Amazon Bedrock, RAG, and AI assistants.
• Lead architecture governance, resiliency design, production RCA, and modernization.
• Identify AI use cases to improve operational efficiency and developer productivity.

Technical Architect – Accenture | May 2019 – Nov 2025

Led architecture for enterprise GenAI platforms integrating LLMs, Azure OpenAI, Amazon Bedrock, AI agents, RAG and enterprise APIs.
• Designed reusable AI accelerators, prompt templates, orchestration workflows and governance patterns.
• Built hybrid AI solutions integrating enterprise applications, Python services and .NET microservices.
• Led AI innovation programs, architecture reviews, POCs and engineering enablement.
• Mentored architects and engineers in AI Engineering, cloud-native architecture and enterprise integration.

Earlier Experience

Cognizant – Senior Technical Lead (2011–2019)
CSC – Team Lead (2007–2011)
Satyam – System Analyst (2005–2007)
USAS LLC – Programmer (2000–2005)
Delivered enterprise application modernization, cloud migration, API integration and engineering leadership.

SELECTED ENTERPRISE ENGAGEMENTS

Xome, CVS Health, TIAA, Walmart, CAT, XL Reinsurance, Emblem Health, IMF, Trafigura.
Delivered AI platform architecture, enterprise modernization, cloud-native integration, distributed systems, AI-powered automation, secure APIs and large-scale digital transformation.

CERTIFICATIONS

Microsoft PL-600 – Power Platform Solution Architect
• Automation Anywhere Certified
• Microsoft Learn AI & Azure Badges
• Enterprise GenAI Certifications

EDUCATION

Master of Computer Applications (MCA)
Tranquebar Bishop Manickam Lutheran College
